values.meaning: Shadow Assassin bonus magic damage as percent of post-mitigation damage dealt
values.binNote: Wiki gives 20% to 40% by level (pplevel), matching the bin's KaynAssMinValue=0.2/KaynAssMaxValue=0.4 bounds exactly. However the per-level formula PAmpPercentBaseAss=18.823 + PAmpPercentPerLvlAss=1.1777*(level-1) yields 18.823 at level 1 and 38.84 at level 18, not exactly 20/40; the true interpolation curve is unclear (linear interpolation shown here is a guess), so listed values are approximate placeholders derived from linear interpolation between the wiki's stated 20 and 40 bounds, not the raw bin formula.

mechanics.claim: Kayn gathers orbs from champion takedowns and each instance of damage dealt against champions, excluding damage over time.
mechanics.quote: He gathers orbs from champion takedowns and each instance of damage (excluding damage over time) dealt against champions.

mechanics.claim: The Shadow Assassin bonus does not trigger on true damage and true damage does not refresh its out-of-combat timer.
mechanics.quote: The ''Shadow Assassin Bonus'' will not be triggered nor have its out-of-combat timer be refreshed if '''Kayn''' deals {{tip|true damage|{{as|true damage}}}}.

mechanics.claim: If the Shadow Assassin bonus is granted by the triggering hit itself, that same instance of damage benefits from the bonus.
mechanics.quote: If the ''Shadow Assassin Bonus'' is granted by '''Kayn''' dealing damage, the triggering instance of damage will benefit from the bonus.

mechanics.claim: The Shadow Assassin bonus damage does not inherit the damage tags (e.g. on-hit qualifiers) of the source that triggered it, unlike normal damage modifiers.
mechanics.quote: Unlike normal damage modifiers, the ''Shadow Assassin Bonus'' does not inherit [[damage]] tags from the source.

mechanics.claim: Recasting Umbral Trespass resets the Shadow Assassin out-of-combat timer for the bonus.
mechanics.quote: with the timer being reset if he recasts ''{{ai|Umbral Trespass|Kayn}}''

mechanics.claim: Only one of the two forms (Rhaast or Shadow Assassin) is active and permanently empowers Kayn's abilities at a time; this passive part only applies once the corresponding form is unlocked and chosen.
mechanics.quote: The transformation will grant a passive bonus and permanently empower some of '''Kayn's''' abilities based on the form chosen.
